name: agent-shell-watch
description: Always-on status line and a pane for this session's Bash calls, background tasks and Codex/Pi/Devin/OpenCodeReview runs: elapsed time, output freshness, verdicts and errors.

columns.title: Pane width
columns.description: Columns asked for the docked pane; a width you drag it to wins

openOnStart.title: Open on start
openOnStart.description: Open the pane when the session starts (the engine keeps an unasked pane hidden below 144 columns)

maxCalls.title: Calls kept
maxCalls.description: How many calls the list keeps, oldest finished ones dropped first

quietMin.title: Quiet after (min)
quietMin.description: Minutes without new output before a running call shows as quiet

hangMin.title: Hung after (min)
hangMin.description: Minutes without new output before a running call shows as hung

statusLine.title: Status line
statusLine.description: Show the always-on status line while anything runs or just failed
